teaching.en: At the community centre, first pick up the visitor badge at reception. Next, fill in the attendance card with your group name and meeting number. Check that the contact field is complete. Finally, turn on the room projector, enter the session code and wait for the welcome screen. Keep the badge and card during the workshop. This practical note gives three complete actions, correct objects and a useful order for every participant.

answer.text: First, go to Desk Four and pick up the parcel with your name on it. Next, fill in the collection form and write code K28 in the reference box. Check that every required field is complete. Finally, turn on the green reader and place the parcel code under it. Keep the receipt after the reader confirms the number. These steps complete the collection in a clear and useful order. Follow this order.
accepted: First, go to Desk Four and pick up the parcel with your name on it. Next, fill in the collection form and write code K28 in the reference box. Check that every required field is complete. Finally, turn on the green reader and place the parcel code under it. Keep the receipt after the reader confirms the number. These steps complete the collection in a clear and useful order. Follow this order.

At Desk Four, pick the parcel up after staff check your name. Then fill the collection form in, using K28 as the reference code, and check all required fields. After that, turn the green reader on and scan the code on the parcel. Wait for its confirmation and keep your receipt. The three instructions place each object correctly and guide the user through the collection process in order. Follow this order.

answer.text: First, pick up the reserved envelope at Window Two and check your name. Next, fill in the registration card, including number B17 in the reference field. Review the card so no required box is empty. Finally, turn on the blue terminal and enter the envelope code. Wait until the terminal confirms it, and keep both the card and receipt. This order makes the three practical actions easy to follow. Follow this order.
